title: HtmlTable
responsibility: Renders the native table element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTable.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native table element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlTable
outputs.description: The actual native table element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.
